# kalvin.io

> Portfolio and Japanese utility tools by Kal.L (Calvin), a fullstack engineer in Tokyo.

## About

- Kal.L (Calvin) is a fullstack engineer based in Tokyo, Japan.
- Focus areas: AI agents, speech systems, TypeScript, Python, Go, and fast web interfaces.
- Portfolio: https://kalvin.io/
- GitHub: https://github.com/kalvin807

## Tools

- [便利ツール集](https://kalvin.io/tool): index of the Japanese utility tools.
- [和暦・西暦変換](https://kalvin.io/tool/date): converts between Japanese era years (Meiji, Taisho, Showa, Heisei, Reiwa) and Gregorian dates. Accepts formats such as `2024-01-15`, `2024年1月15日`, `令和6年1月15日`, `R6.1.15` and `19970224`. Shows the era, sexagenary cycle, weekday, Japanese public holiday, star sign, and time relative to today. Covers dates from 23 October 1868 onward.
- [マップコード変換](https://kalvin.io/tool/mapcode): finds Japanese mapcodes from a Japanese address, a Google Maps or Apple Maps share link, or coordinates such as `26.694333, 127.877833`. Japan only. Mapcodes come from japanmapcode.com. "マップコード" and "MAPCODE" are registered trademarks of Denso Corporation.
